# Audio metadata fixtures

`sound_5.oga` is the unchanged WPT `media/sound_5.oga` asset from snapshot
`db95fafd1fcef8428805e41eb5705d444e8c67ce`, covered by `WPT-LICENSE.md`.
Its Vorbis identification rate is 22,050 Hz and its final granule position
is 110,255 samples. Tests also build synthetic Ogg pages for chaining,
continuation, checksum failures, invalid metadata and scan limits.
